description: index-scans.md is the hub of the 8.0 indexes module - all four sibling pages (covering-indexes.md, index_pushdowns.md, groupby-aggregate-performance.md, early-filters-and-pagination.md) end with a Related Links list, and all four link INTO its #query-execution-details anchor - but index-scans.md itself has no Related Links section and only two outbound links in the whole page. A reader who follows 'Query Execution: Details' from any sibling reaches a dead end. The same is true of the Capella copy.
note: The module's cross-referencing is entirely one-directional into its longest page. Also noted while mapping the topology: early-filters-and-pagination.md's Related Links has SEVEN entries (the four siblings plus WHERE, ORDER BY and OFFSET/LIMIT in the language reference) where the other three have four - so the module has three different link conventions across five pages.
